name: Staked USDai
oneLiner: sUSDai is USD.AI's staked wrapper of USDai; share price accrues yield from a PYUSD liquid sleeve and GPU-backed AI-compute loans, with a 30-day queued exit.
collateral: Yield-bearing USD.AI position backed by a mixed reserve stack that currently pairs a large PYUSD liquid sleeve with GPU-backed infrastructure loans financing AI compute; current issuer materials describe value-warranty coverage on new GPU loans
pegMechanism: Stake USDai to receive sUSDai; the token appreciates versus USDai as yield accrues, while unstaking enters the protocol's queued withdrawal flow with fixed 30-day processing windows and a limited instant-liquidity buffer

sources.label: Arbitrum PublicNode asset() read at block 491177809 (2026-07-30)

dependencyReview.rationale: The complete effective dependency set of sUSDai is one serial wrapper claim on USDai covering the whole share: the reviewed Arbitrum ERC-4626 vault mints sUSDai only against USDai deposits, and asset() re-verified live at Arbitrum block 491177809 (2026-07-30) returned USDai 0x0A1a1a107E45b7CeD86833863F482Bc5f4eD82EF. The curated PYUSD reserve slice is the look-through of the parent's 100%-PYUSD backing and is inherited through this serial edge, not mapped as a parallel collateral edge; the GPU-loan bucket is untracked exogenous private credit. The Ethereum, Base, and Plasma OToken satellites are LayerZero mint-route controls reviewed under bridgeRouteRisk, not separate economic dependencies.

relationships.reason: sUSDai is minted only by depositing USDai into the reviewed Arbitrum ERC-4626 vault (asset() = USDai, re-verified at Arbitrum block 491177809 on 2026-07-30), so the whole sUSDai claim resolves serially to the usdai-usd-ai parent.

proofOfReserves.provider: USD.AI on-chain reserve index; GPU collateral self-disclosed

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: sUSDai is the GPU-financing and private-credit vault layer and intentionally departs from the liquid USDai reserve receipt.
